headline: INDIA SILVER DROUGHT: IMPORT CURBS SLASH VOLUMES 91%, PREMIUMS SURGE TO $6.50/OZ — 6-MONTH HIGH
snippet: India — the world's largest silver consumer, meeting over 80% of demand via imports — has seen monthly silver imports collapse from 534 tonnes a year ago to just 46.8 tonnes in May after the government restricted imports in mid-May, tightened rules further in June, and raised import duties to 15% from 6%. The resulting domestic shortage has pushed spot premiums over benchmark prices to $6.50 per ounce as of July 8, the highest in six months — a squeeze that simultaneously signals acute physical tightness within the world's largest silver market and raises questions about whether suppressed Indian demand will weigh on global spot prices or simply divert buying to less transparent channels. For retail silver investors, the divergence between physical premiums rising and spot prices falling is exactly the kind of dislocation that historically precedes a re-convergence trade.

headline: NGEX LUNAHUASI PHASE 4 FINAL: 19.00M AT 25.84% CUEQ WITHIN 57.75M AT 9.41% — ARGENTINA COPPER-SILVER BEHEMOTH (TSX:NGEX)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / NGEx Minerals Ltd.
snippet: NGEx Minerals (TSX: NGEX) released Phase 4 results on July 8 with highlight hole DPDH078 cutting 19.00 metres at 25.84% CuEq within a broader 57.75-metre interval at 9.41% CuEq at the Lunahuasi copper-gold-silver deposit in San Juan Province, Argentina — grades rarely seen in any bulk-tonnage copper discovery context and more typical of high-grade polymetallic massive sulphide systems than large porphyries. Phase 4 totalled 27,318 metres across 32 holes, with assays from the final five holes still pending; the program has progressively extended the Saturn and Jupiter zones across a footprint now spanning more than 400 × 500 metres. Lunahuasi is emerging as one of the highest-grade undeveloped copper discoveries in the Americas, adjacent to the Josemaría and Filo del Sol mega-porphyry complex, in a country whose mining jurisdiction has improved materially under the Milei administration.

headline: 55 NORTH STEPS OUT 300M AT LAST HOPE — 19.42M AT 2.49 G/T AU EXTENDS RESOURCE INTO VIRGIN GROUND IN MANITOBA (CSE:FFF)
source_name: Investing News Network / 55 North Gold Inc.
snippet: 55 North Gold (CSE: FFF) released July 7 results from its 2026 winter diamond drill program at the Last Hope Gold Deposit in northern Manitoba — located 10 km south of Alamos Gold's Lynn Lake Project — with seven holes extending gold mineralisation 300 metres beyond the current resource boundary to the southeast. The best intercept returned 19.42 metres at 2.49 g/t Au including 4.50 metres at 5.34 g/t Au, from consistent quartz-pyrite shear zone structures confirmed in every hole. The southeast step-out remains open along strike and at depth, setting up a forthcoming resource update on a Manitoba gold system in an under-explored greenstone belt that shares structural geology with the Lynn Lake and Leaf Rapids camps — and where proximity to Alamos Gold's operating infrastructure provides a natural strategic acquirer context.

headline: ALGO GRANDE MAPS THREE PORPHYRY INTRUSIVE CENTRES AT ADELITA — MEZQUITAL BODY 2.2KM×700M AT DEPTH, SECOND RIG MOBILIZING (TSXV:ALGR)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Algo Grande Copper Corp.
snippet: Algo Grande Copper (TSXV: ALGR) announced July 8 that 3D magnetic vector inversion of a high-resolution UAV survey across the 5,895-hectare Adelita Project in Sonora, Mexico has delineated three distinct porphyry-related intrusive centres at depth: the Mezquital body (2.2 km × 700 m, peak 2,100 nT, estimated vertical extent ~750 m), a deep source beneath Cerro Grande Central, and a newly identified La Corona body to the south. Four structural families were confirmed, with the NW-SE and N-S intersection controlling the known Cerro Grande discovery — textbook porphyry architecture. With a second drill rig mobilizing and first Phase 2 assays targeted for August, Adelita's subsurface footprint has expanded from a single-intrusion target to a multi-centred copper district — a structural upgrade that multiplies potential discovery scale before any Phase 2 assay result has been released.

headline: F4 URANIUM AND URANIUMX CONFIRM TWO RADIOACTIVE TRENDS AT MURPHY LAKE — 2,697 CPS AT UNCONFORMITY, ASSAYS H2 2026 (TSXV:FFU)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / F4 Uranium Corp.
snippet: F4 Uranium Corp. (TSXV: FFU) and UraniumX Discovery Inc. completed a 9-hole, 4,092-metre 2026 drill program at Murphy Lake in Saskatchewan's Athabasca Basin — running 60% over budget by metres due to strong geological results — and confirmed two distinct mineralised trends: the Murphy Lake South Trend with nearly 1.3 km of radioactive strike, and the Murphy Lake North Trend with anomalous radioactivity over 330 metres. Hole ML26-023 produced downhole gamma readings peaking at 2,696.9 cps over 3.2 metres at the unconformity — the structural depth position associated with every high-grade Athabasca Basin uranium discovery — with chemical assays expected in H2 2026. For investors in Athabasca Basin exploration, two confirmed trends at unconformity depth, with scintillometer readings well above background, is the earliest-stage indicator that warrants further drilling before any resource is defined.

headline: MIDLAND EXPLORATION FIRES 3,500M AT WILLBOB GOLD IN LABRADOR TROUGH — 5 ZONES, 24 HOLES, ADJACENT TO 2025 KAN ACQUISITION (TSXV:MD)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Midland Exploration Inc.
snippet: Midland Exploration Inc. (TSXV: MD) commenced a 24-hole, 3,500-metre diamond drill program at its wholly owned Willbob property in the Labrador Trough, Quebec on July 8, targeting five defined zones — Ants, Ferricrete, Pump Pad Ridge, Canyon, and Didgeridoo — where prior surface channel sampling at Didgeridoo returned 2.30 g/t Au over 8.95 metres in a structurally controlled setting consistent with orogenic gold systems. The program simultaneously covers prospecting on the adjacent Kan Gold project acquired in 2025, positioning Midland to potentially define a multi-kilometre gold corridor in a region of Quebec that has seen limited modern exploration compared to the Abitibi or James Bay belts. Midland's explorer-business model — systematic prospect generation through geological expertise rather than single-asset concentration — gives the Labrador Trough program a portfolio context: a discovery here adds to an already productive pipeline rather than bet-the-company tension.

headline: NORTHWEST COPPER KWANIKA: 3 RIGS DRILLING, 10,000M PROGRAM UNDERWAY TO SUPPORT PEA — BC COPPER-GOLD PORPHYRY (TSXV:NWST)
snippet: NorthWest Copper Corp. (TSXV: NWST) confirmed July 9 that three diamond drill rigs are active at the 100%-owned Kwanika copper-gold porphyry project in north-central British Columbia, targeting resource upgrades and expansions of the Western Zone underground and Kwanika North open-pit in a fully funded 10,000-metre programme backed by a recent $13.8 million raise. The programme feeds directly into a Preliminary Economic Assessment expected later in 2026 — the economic milestone that resets how the market values a bulk-tonnage porphyry — on a BC project that has already returned palladium credits from recent drilling. Three rigs simultaneously active is an operational intensity signal: it means the company has both the capital and the geological confidence to accelerate rather than pace the 2026 season.

headline: INDONESIA REVERSES NICKEL CURBS — QUOTA RAISED TOWARD 360MT, NICKEL DROPS TO $16,300/T AS SUPPLY CEILING LIFTS
snippet: Indonesia is weighing a raise of its 2026 nickel mining quota to approximately 360 million tonnes — reversing the production curbs imposed earlier in the year that had briefly supported prices — with nickel sliding to $16,300 per tonne on July 8, its lowest since late December 2025, as the potential quota reversal compounds the concurrent ramp-up of Nickel Industries' Excelsior HPAL plant. For battery metals investors, the Indonesia reversal removes the supply-discipline signal that had underpinned the early-2026 nickel rally: a government willing to reverse output curbs under fiscal pressure behaves as a swing supplier, not a resource-scarcity story, and the pattern is a recurring feature of Indonesian commodity policy that has repeatedly punished investors who treated temporary quotas as structural reform. This distinguishes the 2026 nickel setup from cobalt and lithium supply stories where the supply restraint derives from cost curves and project timelines rather than administrative discretion.

headline: DRC COPPER-COBALT MINERS GET JULY 31 ULTIMATUM: PROVE 5% CONGOLESE EMPLOYEE OWNERSHIP OR FACE ENFORCEMENT
snippet: DRC Mines Minister Louis Watum has set a firm July 31, 2026 deadline for all copper and cobalt mining companies operating in the country to demonstrate that at least 5% of their share capital is held by Congolese employees — or face compliance enforcement from a government that suspended cobalt exports earlier in 2026 and has shown it will use resource leverage as policy pressure. The directive affects every major operator in the Katanga copper belt, including Glencore, Ivanhoe Mines, and multiple mid-tier producers whose corporate structures were not designed for mandatory employee equity at this scale, creating a three-week scramble for legal restructuring or documentation filing. For investors holding DRC-exposed copper or cobalt equities, the July 31 deadline is a material regulatory event: the DRC's track record of enforcement means this is not a paper deadline, and the cost and complexity of compliance will differentially affect smaller operators with less legal infrastructure than the majors.

headline: CRITICAL ONE ENERGY HITS 70.3% ANTIMONY OVER 1.1M IN ONTARIO — HOWELLS LAKE RANKS AMONG HIGHEST WESTERN GRADES THIS YEAR (CSE:CRIT)
source_name: Mining Technology / Critical One Energy Inc.
snippet: Critical One Energy (CSE: CRIT) released 2026 drill assay results from its Howells Lake Antimony-Gold Project in Ontario showing hole seven of the program returned 4.17 metres at 27.35% antimony — including a 1.10-metre interval grading 70.3% Sb with visible stibnite — extending the known mineralised corridor along strike within a structural setting now confirmed across multiple holes. With China's antimony export restrictions in force since December 2024, Howells Lake's grades position it as one of the highest-grade stibnite occurrences reported by a Western junior in 2026, distinct from the Victorian gold-antimony systems in Australia and from the tungsten-adjacent antimony plays in Nevada. Ontario's Howells Lake carries infrastructure and jurisdiction advantages that remote-location antimony discoveries cannot match, and at 70.3% Sb in the high-grade interval, the mineralogy is exceptional enough to warrant attention even in a sector where diluted intercepts often tell a different story.
